_about: One short original rundown per day (YYYY-MM-DD, Central time), written by the morning update. Shown at the top of longhornsdaily.com/archive/<date>.
2026-11-17: Texas is 8-2 (5-2 SEC) after Arch Manning's 4-yard touchdown pass to Raleek Brown with three seconds left beat LSU 22-21 in Baton Rouge on Saturday. The Longhorns host Arkansas at 2:30 p.m. Saturday in their final home game, and Sean Miller's men's team, which edged Baylor 75-72 in San Antonio on Sunday, is back in Moody Center Thursday against Southern Utah.
